title: Zenith Weekly Velocity Compass — 14d sprint (personal)
content:
Sprint window: 2025-01-08 → 2025-01-21
Owner: Luisa Rodriguez (personal velocity tracker)
Context: lightweight, private scratchpad to force weekly accountability. Not a product doc — my raw notes for focus optimization and small experiments.

Top objectives (14d):
1) Ship dedicated onboarding checklist for two pilot customers (min viable docs + scripts) — target: 2 pilots onboarded by end of sprint.
2) Protect 12 deep-work hours (blocks of 2 hours) for infra-heavy tasks (benchmarks, perf regression triage).
3) Reduce my PR review lag from avg 26h → <=12h for high-priority labels.

Key metrics (tracked weekly):
- Onboarding pilots started: 1 (pilot-beta1 started 2025-01-10)
- Onboarding pilots completed: 0 (blocking: pilot infra permissions)
- Deep work hours logged: 6/12
- PR review lag (high-priority): avg 20h → trending down
- Meetings attended: 8 (aim <=7)

Weekly check-in template (copy each Monday):
- Wins: 
  * Small: cleaned up onboarding script (bootstrap.sh) to avoid manual steps.
  * Big: demo with pilot1 showed config mismatch discovered early.
- Blockers:
  * Pilot infra IAM: waiting on security approval (CON-5312). Email follow-up Tue.
  * Context switching: pulled into two long syncs - limit ad-hoc unless critical.
- Hypotheses to test:
  * H1: If I reserve morning deep blocks (9–11) for heavy work, I will complete at least 75% of bench tasks planned.
  * H2: Shorter, fixed review windows reduce PR lag more than ad-hoc checks.

Action items (this sprint):
- A1 (Luisa): Send gentle escalation email to security and attach minimal risk assessment. Due 2025-01-13.
- A2 (Luisa): Create REVIEW_SLOT calendar blocks (Mon/Wed/Fri 15:00–16:00) and notify team. Done: draft posted 2025-01-09, still need team buy-in.
- A3 (Luisa): Run perf smoke on quantized model variant; capture 3 data points (latency p50/p95, memory). Target: 2025-01-15.
- A4 (Luisa): Draft onboarding runbook v0.2 (screenshots + troubleshooting). Link to JIRA-ENG-1427.

Weekly rituals (experiments):
- Micro-retro Friday: 15 minutes to jot 3 improvements. Keeps momentum. (Yesterday: skipped, re-add).
- Focus anchor: 2x2hr morning blocks — treat as meeting-free. If interrupted, move meeting, not work.
- Review slot: 3x/week for PRs labeled priority:fast-review.

Notes-to-self / rough threads:
- If security asks for full architecture doc, produce a 1-pager with clear risk mitigations instead of full Confluence dump. Less friction.
- Consider pairing with Raj on perf run to speed setup; pair time reduces mistakes. Ping him after pilot call.
- Stop over-scheduling syncs that are 1:1 info-only. Convert to async notes + quick async ask.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: Pilot stalls for >2 weeks -> backfill with internal demo customers. Action: prepare fallback demo by 2025-01-18.
- Risk: Too many context switches -> mitigation: enforce two deep-work mornings and set Slack status.

Open questions (to answer this sprint):
- Q1: What is minimal set of logs we need to enable for pilot to diagnose model fallback issues?
- Q2: Can we ship onboarding without storage KMS integration for pilot (use temporary alias)? Who owns temporary keys?

Draft messaging (to pilot1):
Hi team — quick status: onboarding script updated, one config mismatch found and patched. Security review pending; ETA for full access 5–7 business days. If you want a walkthrough earlier I can schedule a short call — otherwise I’ll continue with internal prep.

Friction log (quick bullets):
- Manual step in bootstrap.sh around dataset path — fix is committed but need pilot to re-run.
- Demo infra had stale env var for model variant; remind platform to version assets.

End-of-sprint reflection prompts (copy to final retro):
- Did I protect the 12 deep-work hours? If not, why?
- Which action prevented or accelerated onboarding?
- What habit change made the biggest difference this sprint?

Quick links: JIRA-ENG-1427 (onboarding), CON-5312 (security review), slack:#pilot-onboard, github:pr/3389 (bootstrap fix).

Tiny wins log (motivational):
- 2025-01-09: automated env check added — saves ~6 min per local run.
- 2025-01-10: pilot first handshake succeeded.

Random scraps / shorthand (brain dump):
- Try time-blocking email: 11:30–12:00 only.
- If review slot adoption low, make it 30m/day instead of 1h thrice weekly.
- Re-evaluate after next 2 sprints.

TODO (next 48h):
- escalate security (email) | attach 1-pager risk | CC Raj.
- set calendar REVIEW_SLOT + ping team for opt-in.
- run perf smoke and capture numbers, stash in ./benchmarks/bench-20250115.txt

--
Personal note: keep it messy. This is intentionally a fast, raw surface for decisions rather than a polished plan. If something becomes important, move to Confluence and formalize.
